reasoning_traces.think:
The system's core logic hinges on separating confidence (a calibrated probability) from ranking (a heuristic score). Confidence is derived through logistic regression heads per sport-market, ensuring each model is tailored to sport-specific dynamics. The edge computation is a normalized deviation from market prices, enabling a consistent scoring mechanism. Signal slates are generated independently of book prices, preserving model integrity. The static thresholds for grading ensure consistency across picks. Failure modes include misalignment between model and market, or insufficient signal diversity from beat sources. Calibration ensures that 70% confidence corresponds to 70% actual win rate.
